cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When the boss called us office furniture, did it hurt? Please give me your reaction, not your view of his management style.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've drafted one. That's not what I asked. Before I read it to you, tell me what the remark did to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I felt invisible. Twelve years here and apparently I'm a chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I went home and cried. Mine says 'unprofessional'; that's imprecise. I'll change it to what happened. Please stay while I write that sentence.

reason: Make A control the order and precision of the inquiry, revealing personal hurt only after B's admission and revising the protective complaint wording.
